description: Binary MLP probe predicting concept-token presence from sanitized embeddings under each noise condition

conditions.anisotropic: Condition A: MahalanobisNoiseSampler with concept-specific sigma
conditions.smoothed: Condition C: MahalanobisNoiseSampler with smoothed sigma (lambda=0.2)

key_finding: All noise conditions reduce token-presence leakage to near chance (AUC ~0.52, accuracy ~0.51), while clean embeddings allow AUC=0.86. Anisotropic noise provides equivalent token-level privacy to isotropic noise, confirming that concept-choice leakage does NOT compromise per-document token-level privacy.
